data.name: Aazimah
data.gender_notes: Aazimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is growing, expanding, and nurturing. The name Aazimah carries the meaning “Growing, Expanding” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aazimah usually hope their child will grow to embody growing, expanding and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents personal growth and spiritual expansion.
data.etymology: Aazimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Growing, Expanding.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aazimah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aazimah is believed to have its roots in the Arabic language where 'Aazima' means expanding, growing and nurturing. The name represents someone who is constantly expanding their knowledge, growing as a person, and nurturing relationships with others. In Islamic cultures, the name Aazimah is also associated with the idea of striving for excellence and continuous improvement, which is encouraged in the Islamic faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aazimah holds great spiritual significance in Islam as it reflects the idea of constant spiritual growth and development. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his Charity." (Muslim) Thus, the continuous nurturing and growth of one's faith, through acts of charity, good deeds, and seeking knowledge, is a fundamental aspect of Islam. The name Aazimah serves as a reminder to strive for growth in faith, knowledge, and character, and to continually seek the pleasure of Allah through acts of worship and good deeds.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Growing, Expanding" symbolizes The one who is growing, expanding, and nurturing.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aazimah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of growing, expanding.
